summary: Victim received a physical letter impersonating Ledger that claimed a mandatory quantum resistance security update was required. The letter instructed the recipient to scan a QR code likely intended to direct victims to a fraudulent website and obtain wallet credentials or approvals.
user_mistake: Trusted a physical communication claiming to originate from a wallet provider
prevention: Access wallet services only through official bookmarked channels / Ignore QR codes received through unsolicited mail
